measurement_boundary.ttft_definition: t1-t0 from immediately before execute_prepared(prefill) to immediately after q2_top2

hypotheses.prediction: At least one common prefill SPIR-V binary differs candidate vs safe reference.
hypotheses.primary_test: SHA256 all common prefill SPIR-V artifacts.
hypotheses.falsification: All common prefill SPIR-V SHA256 values match exactly.

hypotheses.prediction: With identical prefill-only conditioning, preparing the Q4_FAST decode pipeline set causes >=10% TTFT increase versus preparing the safe decode pipeline set, reproducibly in both workloads.
Within a fixed decode-pipeline set, FULL_INFERENCE conditioning causes >=10% TTFT increase versus PREFILL_ONLY conditioning, reproducibly in both workloads.
The combined Q4FAST+FULL cell shows material harm not attributable to either preregistered main effect alone.
hypotheses.restriction: Cannot be invoked as a post-hoc free-form explanation; only the preregistered factorial interaction rule may support it.

hypotheses.prediction: No H-DPIPE/H-PRECOND/H-INTERACT gate reproduces after H-ART is controlled.
